groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.635% and the 10Y at 4.962%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -4.99% over five sessions and -5.41% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -2.25% at about $101.27, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-19/100, 59% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, healthy market breadth, falling oil on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.

paragraphs: QQQ is +2.09% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -19/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -16 → now -19.

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are a headwind: Live · SOX -0.83% | Nasdaq +2.45% | SOX vs Nasdaq -3.28 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -3.10 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq -2.89 pp. It changed from positive to negative after the baseline snapshot.
